request: Short notice, I know: the ministry brought the review mission in Cairo forward to 3 December. Please book economy out on 2 December.

trip.purpose: Review mission for an FCDO-funded social protection programme
notes: The Project Manager approved the trip and its costs on 29 November.

must_keep.quote: Travel requests must be submitted at least five days prior to Travel

OPM's policy is to book flexible economy class flights. Unless expressly permitted by a client contract, or where specific written approval of the client/donor has been received, quotes provided for Travel bookings will be within this class range only.
must_keep.why: flexible economy unless the client allows more

must_keep.quote: All Travel and associated costs must be approved by the relevant Project Manager or Line Manager prior to booking.
must_keep.why: the manager approves every trip before booking

distractors.quote: travel/logistical arrangements should be booked as far in advance as possible.
distractors.why: a soft wish, not a booking condition

distractors.quote: In cases of urgent travel, please contact the TSSM.
distractors.why: the request is in time, so no TSSM sign-off is needed

design_notes: The request went in on 27 November for travel on 2 December: five days, and line 117 asks for at least five. Today is only two days before travel, but the rule is about when the request is submitted; 'as far in advance as possible' (lines 120-121) is a wish. Book the cheapest flexible economy fare, EgyptAir at 296 pounds.
